id: title:haacked:run batch flag evaluation under the persons db deadline

review.posthog_relevance: Changes batch flag evaluation behavior: each person's DB query is now bounded by a deadline rather than the page, and failed persons are retried up to a configured maximum. This could prevent page-level timeouts and reduce request latency, while still allowing the page to complete even if some persons remain unresponsive.
review.reason: Adds a per-person database deadline and retry configuration, replacing the previous page-level or no-deadline behavior. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it changes the implementation of batch flag evaluation to protect against page-level hangs while allowing recovery for individual unresponsive records. observations.code_quote: A person that fails at the deadline is evaluated once more with a fresh deadline, up to `MAX_PERSON_RETRIES_PER_PAGE` retries per page.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a retry mechanism for persons whose DB queries time out, bounded by a per-page retry cap. This could reduce the chance of complete page failure while still protecting against unresponsive databases.
